text: The tester shall be able to read the VIN in any diagnostic session, whether in default, programming, or extended mode.
notes: Straightforward read, no session restriction per spec.

text: It shall be possible to read the ECU's manufacturer part number and serial number regardless of which diagnostic session is active.
notes: Both DIDs are readable in all sessions per spec.

text: The tester shall be able to wake the BCM into extended diagnostic mode and return it to the default session afterward.
notes: Basic DiagnosticSessionControl round trip.

text: Entering the flash session shall only be allowed when the required preconditions for reprogramming are satisfied.
notes: 'Required preconditions' is not spelled out; labels assume vehicle_stationary since the spec ties programming-only writes/routines to being parked, even though the session-change rule itself has no explicit guard in the spec.

text: Writing the interior lighting brightness calibration (service 0x2E) shall require the module to be in extended mode and unlocked via security level 1.
notes: Matches write_security_level 0x01 and extended-only write_sessions for DID 0x0100.

text: Changing the ambient lighting color index shall only be permitted after the unlock step, in the right mode.
notes: 'Unlock step' and 'right mode' are unnamed; labels assume security_level_1 and extended_session, the only combination the spec allows for writing this DID.

text: The wiper sensitivity calibration shall reject any value outside its valid 1-5 range with a negative response.
notes: value_range min 1 max 5; write also needs the extended/security-level-1 unlock.

text: Enabling or disabling the wiper auto mode shall reject any coding value other than 0 or 1.
notes: value_range min 0 max 1 for DID 0x0131.

text: The factory reset flag shall only be writable while in the flash session, after the programming-level unlock step, and only while the car is parked.
notes: Mirrors spec conditions.requires [vehicle_stationary] plus programming write_security_level 0x03.

text: Three consecutive failed seed-key attempts at the extended security level (service 0x27) shall lock out further unlock attempts for 10 seconds.
notes: max_attempts 3 and delay_ms 10000 for security level 0x01.

text: The lighting self-test routine must not accept a stop or results request before it has been started.
notes: stop_requires_start and results_requires_start are both true for routine 0x0201.

text: The door actuator calibration routine shall only be allowed to run while the vehicle is parked, not while it is being driven.
notes: Routine 0x0202 conditions.requires [vehicle_stationary].

text: ECU reset shall only support hard reset (0x01) and soft reset (0x03); other reset types shall be rejected.
notes: supported_subfunctions [0x01, 0x03].

text: Reading trouble codes shall only support the status-mask reporting method; other DTC read methods shall be rejected with a negative response.
notes: read_dtc_supported_subfunctions is [0x02] only.

text: Sending a keep-alive (tester present) message shall prevent the diagnostic session from timing out, in every session type.
notes: S3 timer is 5000ms in every session per spec timing block.

text: Updating the coding variant identifier (DID 0x0160) shall only be allowed in the flash session after the programming-level unlock step.
notes: write_sessions [0x02] and write_security_level 0x03 for DID 0x0160.

text: Clearing the fault memory shall be allowed whenever the car is awake.
notes: 'Whenever the car is awake' does not name a session; labels assume default and extended sessions since the spec's programming-session allowed_services list omits service 0x14.

text: When the suppress-positive-response bit is set on a write to the central locking auto-relock setting, the module shall not send a positive response, only negative responses on failure, after the unlock step has been completed in extended mode.
notes: DID 0x0120 write requires security level 0x01 in extended session; suppress-positive-response is a standard sub-function bit on service 0x2E.

text: The factory-restore routine (routine 0x0203) shall be startable only in the flash session with the programming-level unlock step completed, and shall return a pending response before the final result.
notes: Routine 0x0203 is long_running: start answered with 0x78 responsePending before the final positive response.

text: The tester shall be able to request a firmware rollback to the previous calibration version.
notes: Not supported by the spec (no rollback/version-history concept exists); included deliberately with empty targets.
